title: Luna suggestions (findings and selections), authoring assist; remove judge
description:
LLM is for rewrites only.

## Scope
- **Selection rewrites:** `suggest` accepts either a finding or an editor `selection` span (any sentence or paragraph) plus an optional editor note ("shorter", "less formal"); a selection is treated as an ad-hoc finding with no policy.
- `suggest(request)`: one finding + policy (guidance, rewriteGuidance) + surrounding paragraph → 2–3 options with patch spans, `factVerificationRequired`, `unresolvedQuestions`. No decisions file required.
- Model `gpt-6-luna` by default (configurable); send `max_completion_tokens`, omit `temperature`.
- Delete the OpenAI judge lane, canary and judge-dependent `compare` paths; redesign or drop `decide`/`options`/`apply`/`verify` CLI commands around `check` + `suggest` (no compatibility constraint).
- Policy-authoring assist: `draft_questions(guideline)` uses Luna to propose classifier detectors for editor approval; never called from `check`.
- Keep the no-fabrication and evasion guards from `editorial_rewrite_options`.

## Done when
- `suggest` passes fixture tests with a fake resolver; `check` makes no LLM calls.

comments.author: home
comments.text: suggest (findings expand to their sentence; selections exact; editor note; drops identical/duplicate/evasive options and options that still break the triggering rule) and draft_questions (validated noul detectors, defaults 0.8/0.5) done with CLI. Live with gpt-6-luna: finding rewrite 6s, selection 3.5s, draft 4.6s. Legacy judge/scan removal moved to its chore so it ships with the Papyrus migration.
